item: Row I's closing walk: 45-run CSP sweep, 390 px PF10 look, H3 measured, culled themes named, two defects fixed
status: shipped (draft; Chromium-verified in the sandbox, R126)
summary: Three widths x 15 theme settings, every tab and subtab, every drop-down picked and judged, console kept per run: 0 CSP violations, 6,798 picks read back holding the pick (0 reverted, 0 unread, 0 errors; offline app, loopback only); PF10 at 390 px passes 23 of 23 maps that paint here. The walk found the AI backend select flipping back after a pick (a panel load in flight at the pick wrote the old stored value; counted picks and saves in flight now gate the write, measured before and after in Chromium) and python -m src.api.main double-importing the app (a 500 on the Mindmap graph; --ephemeral relaunches that way; the __main__ block now aliases the running module). H3 is measured first and the absorption test does not pass (layered mind-map zoom, the resolved-term header and five pickTerm call sites are open), so the box stays and a test pins it. R125 and R126 recorded.
